'''Serenno''' was a [[planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]' [[D'Astan sector]], covered in lush [[forest]]s, [[mountain]]s and plains. Serenno was named after its ruling family, [[House Serenno]]. During the [[Clone Wars]], it was aligned with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Head of State|leader]] of which was the Serenno-born [[Count]] [[Dooku]]. In the [[Imperial Era]], the planet was occupied by the [[Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
===Astrography===
Serenno was a terrestrial<ref name="DB" /> [[planet]] located in the [[D'Astan sector]]'s [[Serenno system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]], in grid square P-5 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="Appendix" /> Serenno [[orbit]]ed a singular [[star]]<ref name="BMF 70" /> and was orbited by two [[moon]]s, including the moon of [[Mantero]].<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" />

The planet sat at a prime point along a maze of key [[Hyperspace route|hyperspace lanes]], close to the planet [[Toprawa]] and the [[Corporate Sector]] that lay to the northeast, at the very start of the [[Hydian Way]] [[super-hyperroute]]. To the east sat the vast [[Gordian Reach]] and, within it, the [[Yavin system]], while [[Mandalore sector|Mandalorian space]] lay south. A direct route down the Hydian Way to [[Brentaal IV]] would mean a short jump across to the planet [[Coruscant]] and the [[Galaxy|galactic]] seat of power. It was also situated along the [[Spurs of Celanon]].<ref name="BMF 70" />

===Geography===
[[File:SerennoSurface-Nightsisters.png|thumb|left|250px|The forested surface of Serenno at night]]
Its surface was covered in [[forest]]s,<ref name="Spoils of War" /> including lush rainforests, and [[mountain]] ranges.<ref name="BMF 70" /> One particular area was the [[upper forest region]].<ref name="Spoils of War" /> Also present within its geography were savannas, which gave way to rivers that spilled into [[ocean]]s.<ref name="BMF 70" /> [[Serenno silver]] was a type of metal that shared its name with the world.<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The plains of the world hid seams of [[sacanium]] that were discovered during the [[Incident on Serenno|Invasion of Serenno]].<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" />

===Fauna===
Many animal species lived on the planet such as [[spikebat]]s, [[spine-wolves]], and the most famous, the [[Tirra'Taka]]–a member of an ancient species of reptilian dragons. The Tirra'Taka was corrupted by those using [[Dark side of the Force|the dark side]], but it was able to break free from the dark side's control and manipulation, and later became trapped beneath the surface of the planet. The dragon who broke through the dark side ended up becoming a Serennian legend.<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" />

==History==
===Early history===
According to the legends of the noble houses of the planet, Serenno was once a planet under the control of the [[Sith Empire]]. While the Sith Empire controlled the planet, dark side force users found and corrupted the Tirra'Taka for use in battle. At some point, the seven [[Great Houses|great houses]] were mobilized by [[House Serenno]] and, according to their histories, [[Battle on Serenno|expelled]] the Sith forces without Jedi assistance. During the battle, the Tirra'Taka broke free and became trapped underneath the surface of the planet where it later became a Serennian Legend. As a result of the battle, the planet was subsequently renamed in honor of [[Serenno (individual)|Serenno]], a member of House Serenno. Later, he formed the planetary [[Great Houses|council]] and joined the [[Galactic Republic]]. He also formed the [[Serenno military]] as the planetary defense force protecting the Serenno system and its planet, Serenno.<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" />

Sometime later, a tale arose of a [[Gender|female]] [[Theelin]] [[archaeologist]] called [[Loreth (archaeologist)|Loreth]] who was determined to find a [[Burial|tomb]] of a [[Darth Siberus|lost princess]]. Over the years while doing an apprenticeship, she was economical with her [[Currency|money]] and made some money from selling her discoveries to [[collector]]s on worlds such as [[Naboo]] and Serenno.<ref name="Sleep of Ages">{{StoryCite|story=The Sleep of Ages|book=Dark Legends}}</ref>

===High Republic Era===
Around [[232 BBY]]<ref name="Light of the Jedi Date note">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]'' to [[232 BBY]].</ref> during the [[High Republic Era]], the planet was represented in the Galactic Republic by [[Senator]] [[Izzet Noor]], who was also the spokesperson for the majority of Outer Rim locations that had been brought under the Republic's control.<ref name="Light of the Jedi">''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]''</ref> By [[231 BBY]],<ref name="Date 231 BBY">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[The High Republic: The Rising Storm]]'', during which [[Kresto]] was [[Count of Serenno]], to [[231 BBY]].</ref> [[Kresto]] held the title [[Count of Serenno]].<ref name="Rising Storm">''[[The High Republic: The Rising Storm]]''</ref>

By [[102 BBY]],<ref name="DJLBirths">According to ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'', Dooku was eighty [[Standard year|years]] old at the time of the [[First Battle of Geonosis]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the Battle of Geonosis in [[22 BBY]], therefore putting Dooku's birth year in 102 BBY. The [[Dooku: Jedi Lost (script)|script]] of ''[[Dooku: Jedi Lost]]'' establishes that [[Zang Arraira]], [[Sifo-Dyas]], and [[Arath Tarrex]] are the same age as Dooku, which also puts their births in 102 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]].</ref> Serenno was ruled by [[Count]] [[Gora]]. Shortly after the birth of his second son, [[Dooku]], Gora realized that the boy was [[Force-sensitive]]; due to his hatred of them, Gora quickly contacted the [[Jedi Order]] and then left the boy alone in a [[Unidentified forest|forest]] outside of his palace to die or be found by the [[Jedi seeker]]s. Gora subsequently refused to speak of Dooku. As such, his other two children, [[Ramil]] and [[Jenza]], and the wider Serennian public were initially unaware of Dooku's existence.

===Before the Clone Wars===
Gora's rule was unpopular for many Serennians due to him often laying off workers and replacing them with [[droid]]s. He also dismantled the Serenno Military with security droids loyal to him and subsequently, many of the other Houses began dismantling their own House Guards in favor of droids.<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" /> Around [[90 BBY]]<ref name="Date2">According to ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'', [[Dooku]] was eighty [[Standard year|years]] old at the time of the [[First Battle of Geonosis]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the Battle of Geonosis in [[22 BBY]], placing Dooku's birth year in [[102 BBY]]. The [[Dooku: Jedi Lost (script)|script]] of ''[[Dooku: Jedi Lost]]'' states that Dooku was twelve years old at the time of the celebration, placing the celebration around [[90 BBY]].</ref>, a [[Celebration on Serenno|celebration]] was hosted at Carannia on the planet which brought citizens all over the galaxy and [[Jedi]] to the planet. An incident occurred during the celebration where a sudden earthquake caused the [[Great Assembly House]] in Carannia to collapse which buried [[Jedi Initiate]] Dooku and Jenza, Dooku's sister. They were then saved by [[Jedi Master]]s and after the discovery of Dooku coming to Serenno, Gora ordered Grand Master Yoda and the Jedi to leave his planet. This revealed to Dooku that Gora was his father.<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" />

Gora's unpopular rule led to a protest in<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" /> [[82 BBY]]<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> at the [[Funeral of Countess Anya]] while Jenza was giving a speech about her mother, during which Gora almost ordered his Security Droids to fire on the protestors until Dooku intervened. This intervention unwittingly reveals Dooku's identity as Gora's son to the Serennian public.<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" />

By [[42 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> Count Gora was replaced by his son Ramil who continued his father's work of dismantling the Serenno Military in favor of droids. While in power, as part of an elaborate scheme to remove the infighting between the Great Houses, he allowed pirates to repeatedly raid the planet and its capital. This forced the Great Houses to hire [[Abyssin]] [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] which were eventually bought out by Ramil who ordered them to seize control of the planet and its capital leading to the Invasion of Serenno. With no support from the [[Jedi Council]] or the Republic, Jedi Masters Dooku, [[Sifo-Dyas]], and [[Lene Kostana]] went to Serenno to aid the resistance fighters on the planet. While traveling, the [[Truthseeker|ship]] the Jedi Masters were in was shot down and crash-landed on the [[Delgaldon Plains]] on the planet. They then met up with the resistance fighters and launched an attack on an [[Abyssin Outpost]] near Carannia. After capturing the outpost, Ramil and his [[Ramil's droid army|droid army]] intervened where they forcibly disarmed the Jedi Masters and the resistance fighters. Ramil then summoned Dooku to his ship, the ''[[Windrunner]]'', and taunted him about how he will kill all members of the other six Great Houses and kill Jenza. This angered Dooku particularly when Ramil was about to give the order to kill Jenza leading to him summoning the Tirra'Taka which devastated Ramil's droid army. While the Tirra'Taka ravaged the droid army, Dooku killed Ramil. He was then forced to kill the Tirra'Taka after he lost control of the dragon.<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" />

After becoming Count, a title he took on after the invasion of Serenno, Dooku attended a summit requested by the Great Houses in his castle. He then used a seam of scancium discovered near Carannia after the battle to help rebuild Carannia after it was ravaged in 42 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]].<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" />

Sometime before the [[Clone Wars]], Dooku went to the Outer Rim planet [[Sullust]] to help continue the contract negotiations between Serenno and [[SoroSuub Corporation]] in person. He also went to the planet to secretly seek out the [[Kaldana Syndicate]] to ally with his master, Darth Sidious.<ref name="AoR Dooku">[[Age of Republic - Count Dooku 1|''Age of Republic - Count Dooku'' 1]]</ref>

In [[24 BBY]],<ref name="Date4">''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'' states that the Raxus Address took place two [[Standard year|years]] before the [[First Battle of Geonosis]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the Battle of [[Geonosis]] to [[22 BBY]], therefore the Raxus Address must have occurred in [[24 BBY]].</ref> Dooku founded the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], an alliance of [[Star system|solar systems]] who wanted to secede from the Republic. At some point, he moved his headquarters to a [[Castle Serenno|cliff-side castle]] on Serenno.<ref name="DB" /> While ruling as Count, Dooku, like his predecessors, continued to dismantle the Serenno military and replaced workers with droids which caused unemployment to dramatically rise throughout the planet.<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" />

[[File:Ventress-Jedi-Lost.png|thumb|right|220px|Asajj Ventress traveled to her Master's homeworld to find his sister]]
Around [[23 BBY]],<ref name="Dooku Assassin Date">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' places the recruitment of Asajj Ventress as [[Dooku]]'s [[assassin]] to 23 [[Standard year|years]] before the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[23 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''. Therefore, Ventress' recruitment must have occurred in 23 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]]. As ''[[Dooku: Jedi Lost]]'' takes place after Dooku recruited Ventress, the mission must have occurred around 23 BBY.</ref> in the [[Dooku's throne room|great hall]] of his castle, Dooku [[Mission to assassinate Jenza|tasked]] his [[Sith apprentice]] [[Asajj Ventress]] to go and find his sister, [[Lady]] Jenza. For her to find Jenza, she looked through [[datapad]]s and [[Dooku's journal]] and learned how Dooku was before he left the Jedi Order. She finds out that she had been kidnapped and would be tracking [[Glute]], a [[Crolute]] criminal who was hired by Raz Fellidrone. Before Ventress could get information from Glute, a sudden blaster bolt was fired into Glute's head, shot by a [[Republic Intelligence]] officer, [[Raz Fellidrone]]. He tortured Jenza to try to get information out of her to help the Galactic Republic. Ventress caught up with him and stabbed him through his chest with her [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers|lightsaber]] in his [[Fellidrone's Apartment|apartment]] on Serenno. Later Dooku arrived and wanted Jenza to be killed, for the information she held, as Ventress was later ordered. She then said "I'm sorry" as she buried her lightsaber into Jenza's chest in the apartment. Ventress then destroyed all evidence which led to the apartment and the building being destroyed in the resulting fire.<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" />

Shortly before the Clone Wars, the [[Spike (Serenno)|Spike]], a large underground, inverted cone-shaped [[prison]] designed to hold important prisoners, was constructed in the rocky [[Aparian Wastes]] on the planet.<ref name="CoR">''[[Collapse of the Republic]]''</ref>

===The Clone Wars===
[[File:SerennoCity-Nightsisters.png|thumb|left|254px|Serenno was seemingly unaffected throughout the Clone Wars due to a strong defense, yet tensions boiled under the surface as Dooku exploited his own people.]]
The hostility between the Republic and the Confederacy turned into a pan-[[The galaxy|galactic]] conflict known as the Clone Wars, and Serenno became a stronghold of the Confederacy. Protected by a [[Serenno defense fleet|cordon]] of Confederate [[warship]]s, the planet was kept insulated from the worst of the Clone Wars battles.<ref name="DB" /> Dooku, however, funded his war effort with a [[Dooku's war chest|war chest]] of spoils stolen from his people in addition to looting from worlds he had conquered. His exploitation of Serenno led to resentment on the part of his people, whom he treated no differently from other planets he pillaged.<ref name="Ruins of War">{{TBB|Ruins of War}}</ref> Throughout the Clone Wars, Dooku oversaw the [[Separatist Senate]] on the Outer Rim planet [[Raxus Secundus]] from his home, Castle Serenno, via hologram. The planet also acted as a refuge for Dooku where he could meditate in the dark side of the Force.<ref name="DB" />

In the early stages of the Clone Wars, an [[Cadesura disaster|incident]] on the [[Colonies]] planet [[Cato Neimoidia]] led to Dooku making a statement at Castle Serenno, his home on Serenno, where he condemned the Republic for causing the incident on Cato Neimodia in the first place. During the broadcast from his home, he dared the Republic to send [[Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine to Cato Neimodia to prove its innocence.<ref name="Brotherhood">[[Brotherhood (novel)|''Brotherhood'']]</ref>

[[File:SavageScissored-WOTM.jpg|thumb|right|275px|Dooku trained Opress on Serenno]]
In 20 BBY,<ref name="Galactic Atlas3">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> the [[Sith Master]] of Dooku, [[Darth Sidious]], contacted Dooku in his palace via [[hologram]] and ordered the count to get rid of his Sith apprentice Ventress. As Ventress had grown too powerful, Sidious feared that she would pose a threat to his plans. However, Ventress survived Dooku's [[Battle of Sullust|attempt]] to [[Death|kill]] her. After returning to her people on [[Dathomir]], she came back to Serenno with her fellow [[Nightsisters]] [[Karis]] and [[Naa'leth]] who were disguised as Jedi to assassinate Dooku at his palace. Nevertheless, the Nightsisters disguised as Jedi were no match for the count, who used [[the Force]] and [[Telekinesis|hurled]] the intruders out of the palace. After the skirmish, Dooku received a transmission from the Nightsister [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Talzin]], who offered to replace Ventress with [[Savage Opress]], a Dathomirian [[Nightbrothers|Nightbrother]].<ref name="Nightsisters" /> Upon completion of the deal, Opress was delivered to Dooku on Serenno,<ref name="Monster">{{TCW|Monster}}</ref> and the count started to [[Sith training|train]] him on that planet.<ref name="Witches of the Mist">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref>

Sometime later, Dooku summoned eleven of the galaxy's best [[bounty hunter]]s, which included [[Cad Bane]] and [[Rako Hardeen]], secretly [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in disguise, to his home planet. He wanted to recruit the best-suited candidate to take part in [[Moralo Eval]]'s plot to abduct the Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic. In order to do so, Dooku put the bounty hunters in Eval's [[Box]], a cubical structure hosted on Serenno.<ref name="The Box">{{TCW|The Box}}</ref>

[[File:DookuordersGrievous-Massacre.png|thumb|left|300px|Count Dooku gives General Grievous orders]]
Remembering how Savage Opress betrayed him and teamed up with Ventress to kill him, he ordered [[General]] [[Grievous]] in his palace to kill Ventress and massacre the Nightsisters on Dathomir. During the [[Battle of Dathomir]], Mother Talzin attempted to kill Dooku leading to him ordering Grievous via comlink to stop Talzin by following a trail of green mist.<ref name="Massacre">{{TCW|Massacre}}</ref> Dooku was saved when Grievous supposedly killed Talzin. After the battle of Dathomir, Dooku talked to Grievous about how Savage Opress was becoming stronger and how he sensed that something was rising.<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref>

After a malfunction in the [[behavioral modification biochip]] of [[Tup]] caused the [[clone trooper]] to fire on [[Jedi General]] [[Tiplar]], Dooku immediately reported to Darth Sidious of the incident in his palace, where Dooku was ordered by Sidious to seize the clone. Dooku obliged and ordered Separatist forces to capture the clone.<ref name="The Unknown">{{TCW|The Unknown}}</ref> Dooku later received the two inhibitor chips from Tup and Fives in his palace that [[Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Fives]] was going to use as evidence to prove his theory regarding the chips. He then contacted Sidious who ordered all evidence including the chips to be destroyed.<ref name="Orders">{{TCW|Orders (episode)}}</ref> Dooku later contacted Sidious who commanded him to help [[Rush Clovis]] take over the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]] and ensure that he has no one else to turn to apart from him.<ref name="Rise2">{{TCW|The Rise of Clovis}}</ref>

During the Clone Wars, Jedi Master [[Plo Koon]] went to the moon of [[Oba Diah]] to examine a signal from its surface. After exploring the surface, Plo Koon found a crashed ship and the [[Sifo-Dyas's lightsaber|lightsaber]] of Sifo- Dyas which caused an investigation into what happened to Sifo Dyas. This led to Sidious contacting Dooku in his palace and [[Force choke|force choking]] him to ensure that Dooku eliminated the loose end before the Jedi discover his [[Order 66|plans]].<ref name="The Lost One">{{TCW|The Lost One}}</ref>

Towards the end of the Clone Wars, Dooku [[Prisoner|imprisoned]] the Jedi [[assassin]] Master [[Quinlan Vos]] at his palace on Serenno. There, the [[Sith Lord]] subjected the Jedi to prolonged periods of [[torture]]. To push him to the dark side, Dooku revealed that his fellow assassin Ventress had [[Battle of unidentified planet (Tholme and Ventress)|murdered]] Vos' late Master [[Tholme]]. Enraged, Vos embraced the dark side and became Dooku's latest apprentice. When Ventress arrived with [[Boba Fett]]'s [[Krayt's Claw|syndicate]] to rescue Vos, he spurned their [[Mission to Serenno (Krayt's Claw)|rescue]] and sided with Dooku.<ref name="Dark Disciple">''[[Dark Disciple]]''</ref>

[[File:Kix-Db.png|thumb|right|200px|The clone trooper Kix was captured and to be brought to Serenno]]
After Dooku found out that [[Kix]] knew about the plot to kill all the Jedi by investigating what Fives claimed, Dooku ordered Kix kidnapped. After capturing and interrogating the clone, the Separatists believed that the clone was deceiving them. Because of this, the Separatists planned to bring the clone to Serenno in the ''[[Obrexta III]]''. While the ''Obrexta III'' was taking off, Republic forces [[Attack in an unidentified sector|ambushed]] the vessel. Under strict orders to not allow the clone to fall into Republic hands and with the ship being unable to go to Serenno due to the ship suffering grievous damage, the cruiser jumped to hyperspace at a random sector where it eventually crash-landed on the Outer Rim planet [[Ponemah Terminal]] in the [[Western Reaches]]''.<ref name="Lost Treasure">{{StoryCite|story=The Crimson Corsair and the Lost Treasure of Count Dooku|book=Tales from a Galaxy Far, Far Away: Aliens: Volume I}}</ref>''

At some point in the Clone Wars, the [[Blockade of Serenno]], in which the CIS used several [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel]]s to protect the planet, acted as an engagement against enemy forces.<ref name="BMF 70" /> In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas3" /> the Republic attempted to capture Serenno in the [[D'Astan campaign]] however failed to do so.<ref name="BMF 70" /> Around 19 BBY,<ref name="Galactic Atlas3" /> Count Dooku sent [[Duke]] [[Solha]] to the Outer Rim planet [[Mokivj]] to turn an existing factory there into a droid factory. While on Mokivj, Duke Solha produced [[C-B3 cortosis battle droid|Cortosis B2 super battle droids]]. Later on, his [[Solha's brother|brother]] and [[Solha's sister|sister]] came to work with him on Mokivj.<ref name="Thrawn: Alliances">''[[Thrawn: Alliances]]''</ref> In the same year,<ref name="The Big Bang Date">{{TCWcanondates|U4}}</ref> Count Dooku ordered General Grievous to bring a large [[kyber crystal]] to the planet however the plan was thwarted by Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="Big Bang">{{TCW|The Big Bang}}</ref>

===Imperial Era===
{{Quote|Serenno is Imperial-occupied.|[[Hunter]]|<ref name="Spoils of War" />}}
[[File:Imperial_operation_serenno.png|thumb|left|348px|Imperial operation on Serenno]]
The Clone Wars ended with the Republic's [[Proclamation of the New Order|transformation]] into the Galactic Empire, only [[Standard day|days]] after Dooku's death during the [[Battle of Coruscant]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> The Empire swiftly conquered and [[Occupation of Serenno|occupied]] Serenno.<ref name="Spoils of War" /> Launching a targeted campaign against the planet's population, many Serennians were killed,<ref name="Ruins of War" /> and at least [[Serenno City|one]] of the planet's cities, in view of Castle Serenno, was destroyed via [[orbital bombardment]].<ref name="Spoils of War" /> Some surviving Serennians, such as [[Romar Adell]], went into hiding on their world. Adell moved into a [[Romar Adell's domicile|hidden home]] in the [[upper forest region]].<ref name="Ruins of War" /> The Empire sent clone troopers led by [[Clone Captain]] [[Wilco]] to Castle Serenno to secure Dooku's riches and transport it off-world.<ref name="Spoils of War" />

The [[pirate]] [[Phee Genoa]] learned of the operation and informed her contact [[Ciddarin Scaleback|Cid]], an [[information broker]] on [[Ord Mantell]]. Cid hoped to secure some of the funds in case she had to flee her operation due to the Empire and persuaded the [[Cloning|clone]] [[Desertion|deserters]] of [[Clone Force 99]], who had been working for her as mercenaries, to try and [[Mission to Castle Serenno|steal]] some of the war chest to secure their futures. When the "Bad Batch" arrived on Serenno, they discovered the destroyed city for themselves on approach to the castle. When they arrived there, they found that the majority of the riches had already been loaded onto three [[class four container transport]]s which were about to depart. Splitting into two groups, the team attempted to steal some of the contents of [[Transport Three]]'s haul, while the [[squad]]'s leader, [[Hunter]], attempted to stage a diversion by blowing up some [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter|V-wing starfighters]].<ref name="Spoils of War" />

Things swiftly went wrong for the would-be thieves, however, and Transport Three took off early with Batch members [[Echo]], [[Tech]], and [[Omega]] still onboard. Hunter and [[Wrecker]] were forced to escape through the castle and out into the ruined city, while the group onboard the [[transport]] resorted to jettisoning its entire load of [[cargo container]]s to return to Serenno's surface after the [[starship]]'s [[escape pod]]s were launched by its crew.<ref name="Spoils of War" /> Wilco led a pursuit into the ruins and ordered other [[trooper]]s after the scattered cargo, which landed in the upper forest region. There, Echo, Omega, and an injured Tech encountered Adell and threatened him into letting them briefly shelter at his house.<ref name="Ruins of War" />

Omega, feeling guilty due to believing she was the reason her brothers were fugitives, snuck back to the cliff where their cargo container had crashed in an attempt to recover some of the riches. Echo discovered she was missing when he returned from a patrol and tracked her down at the same time that Imperial clone troopers discovered the site, forcing him to retreat into the cargo container. Despite his injury, Tech followed them and fought off some clone troopers, with help from Adell once the old man decided to follow. The fight left Omega unable to retrieve any of the war chest as the cargo container was knocked further down the cliff; Echo persuaded her to abandon it before they escaped.<ref name="Ruins of War" />

[[File:Ruins_of_war.png|thumb|right|275px|Serenno City was reduced to ruins]]
In the ruined city, Hunter and Wrecker were tracked and surrounded by [[Wilco's company]] while attempting to find something they could use as a weapon. Wrecker improvised a cannon out of parts of an old Separatist tank which he used to blast his way through enemy lines. The two fugitives were able to escape the city and were chased back to their starship, the [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|''Marauder'']]. Taking off, they rendezvoused with the other members of the Batch and picked them up. Adell declined an offer to come along. Wilco's attempt to truthfully report the incident led to his murder at Castle Serenno by [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart|Rampart]], who was attempting to cover up the Bad Batch's survival of the [[Attack on Kamino|Fall of Tipoca City]] to avoid the displeasure of his superior, [[Governor]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]].<ref name="Ruins of War" />

By [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Date ref">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events on [[Vandor]] and in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' to nine years after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the formation of the Empire to [[19 BBY]]; therefore, the events on Vandor and in ''Solo'' must take place in [[10 BBY]].</ref> [[Chrodber]] served as the Count of Serenno and was a guest aboard the [[First Light]], [[Dryden Vos]]' [[yacht]].<ref name="Official Guide">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]''</ref> In [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{JediSurvivorDate}}</ref> a [[B2-series super battle droid]] recounted that he had carried out patrols on Serenno previously. In the same year, the [[Mirialan]] [[Moran (Koboh)|Moran]] told a story to Jedi Fugitive [[Cal Kestis]] about the [[Incident over Muunilinst|incident]] over the [[Outer Rim Territories]] planet [[Muunilinst]] and how he was accosted by a customs longship due to the fence failing to update [[transponder code]]s. According to Moran, his vessel was marked and boarded by three [[Customs official|customs officers]]. Though Moran attempted to lie to the officers, one officer decided to kick open a shipping container which according to Moran, was full of slightly incriminating powder. In order to hide what really was in the shipping container, Moran told the officers that they were looking at the ashes of a thousand ritually cremated Serennian war heroes. The officers believed Moran's lie leading to Moran being able to evade the officers rather than spending time in a [[Muunilinst Work Camp]].<ref name="Jedi Survivor">''[[Star Wars Jedi: Survivor]]''</ref>

By [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date 1 BBY">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref> [[Corellian]] [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] met a girl named [[Sarla]] in the Carannia Spaceport on Serenno, who fell for Solo's charms.<ref name="PSFB">''[[A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy]]''</ref>

===Later events===
During the [[First Order-Resistance War]], the Serennian mercenary [[Kendoh Voss]] led the [[Kendoh Gang]], intent on restoring her [[Kendoh Voss' family|family's]] once-great fortunes.<ref name="Galaxy's Edge 2">[[Galaxy's Edge 2|''Galaxy's Edge'' 2]]</ref> Voss was known as the "Scourge of Serenno."<ref name="Galaxy's Edge 5">[[Galaxy's Edge 5|''Galaxy's Edge'' 5]]</ref>

==Inhabitants==
===Overview===
{{Quote|And for your information, I am the boss. I am Duke Solha of the Free System of Serenno.|Solha, to Anakin Skywalker and Thrawn|<ref name="Thrawn: Alliances" />}}
Serenno was home to mainly humans, however, the population also included a smattering of [[Chiss]] and [[Twi'lek]]s.<ref name="BMF 70" /> During the Clone Wars, Serenno was the personal stronghold for Count Dooku and was insulated from the War. Although it was politically important to the Confederacy, not many visitors came to Serenno, with those who came to Serenno mainly being prisoners such as Quinlan Voss<ref name="Dark Disciple" /> and people vital to the Confederacy.<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" /> As Dooku exploited his own people for the war effort, the people of Serenno began to turn against their ruler. After the rise of the Empire, however, the Serennian population was persecuted, with survivors such as Romar Adell living in hiding on their planet.<ref name="Ruins of War" />

===Culture===
Serennian [[Noble|nobility]] wore [[Serennian cloak]]s to allow people to identify them as nobility. Count Dooku, Duke Solha, Solha's brother, and Solha's sister all wore Serennian cloaks. Serenno also had many customs which included permitting condemned prisoners one last request.<ref name="Thrawn: Alliances" /> Those of House Serenno that died were buried on Mantero, a moon that orbited the planet Serenno.<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" />

In 19 BBY,<ref name="Galactic Atlas3" /> a Model 2 [[datacore]] containing a fragment of Serennian history, culture, music, arts, and memories was one such item that survived the Imperial Orbital Bombardment of at least 1 city near Castle Serenno. The item was located in Romar Addell's House.<ref name="Ruins of War" />

==Locations==
===Castle Serenno===
{{Main|Castle Serenno}}
Castle Serenno was a luxurious, ornamental castle located on the edge of a cliff overlooking a valley in which stood Serenno City.<ref name="Nightsisters" /> The upper forest region was situated nearby.<ref name="Spoils of War" /> The estate featured ten relay stations and a central main tower that stood twenty-two meters high,<ref name="BMF 70" /> also housing a great hall and a sleeping chamber.<ref name="Nightsisters" /> By 20 BBY,<ref name="Galactic Atlas3" /> the castle housed the Box, a newly constructed cubical structure used to test the skills of bounty hunters.<ref name="The Box" /> Those permitted to enter the castle walked along a long pathway in between the gardens that led to the Castle.<ref name="Nightsisters" />

The castle was the headquarters of House Serenno.<ref name="SW:AEYNtK">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref> During the Clone Wars, it was the residence and stronghold of Count Dooku.<ref name="Nightsisters" /> By 19 BBY,<ref name="Galactic Atlas3" /> during the Imperial Era, the structure was abandoned and later pillaged by the Galactic Empire for Dooku's War Chest.<ref name="Spoils of War" />

===Romar Adell's domicile===
{{Main|Romar Adell's domicile}}
A house belonging to Romar Adell was located in the upper forest region of the planet. An Imperial orbital bombardment of a nearby city close to Castle Serenno forced him to live there. The house featured a basement containing items that survived the orbital bombardment, including a model 2 DataCore containing a fragment of Serennian history and culture.<ref name="Ruins of War" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Serennoconceptart.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art of a Serenno City]]
Serenno first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]] episode [[Nightsisters (episode)|Nightsisters]].<ref name="Nightsisters" />

In the [[2018]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'', Serenno was misspelled as "Serreno."<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]''</ref>
